rules: Content must be generally suitable for advertising, avoiding gratuitous sexual, violent, offensive, or harmful themes.
Avoid depicting sensitive events, illegal activities, or controversial issues without appropriate context or educational value.
Monetization requires content to be original or significantly transformative, adding unique commentary, educational value, or creative input.
Do not monetize unaltered re-uploads of others' content, or compilations of short clips/songs from other creators without substantial original contribution.
Creators must disclose to YouTube when realistic synthetic or AI-generated content depicts events, people, or places that appear real but are not.
Mandatory disclosure is required for AI content that realistically alters a person's speech/actions or depicts real events that didn't occur.
Failure to disclose realistic synthetic content can lead to content removal or suspension from monetization programs.
All synthetic/AI content must still adhere to YouTube's community guidelines, prohibiting hate speech, misinformation, or harassment.
